headline: 'Is KOSPI 7000 Real?' Herd Rally Alarms Retail Investors; Limit-Up Stocks Halved, Only New Lows Emerge [Investment 360]
summary: A total of 112 stocks closed at the daily upper limit through the 23rd this month, versus 234 in January. Analysts question whether a KOSPI level of 7,000 is realistic amid a herd-driven rally.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main equity benchmark, with heavy weighting in semiconductor and large-cap stocks. Breadth and retail participation are common gauges of market sentiment.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Fewer stocks hit the daily upper limit than in January, while retail investors show herd-driven enthusiasm.
